title: Suhyup Bank confirms leak of personal information of 54 customers, inews24 reports
date_note: inews24 (published 27 November) says the bank confirmed the leak the day before.
geo_basis: country; the source does not state the headquarters city
summary: inews24 reports that Suhyup Bank confirmed the leak of personal information of 54 customers and reported it to the Financial Supervisory Service. The article says the data includes loan information, credit information and addresses. Edaily, citing financial-sector sources, says an attacker queried customer data by trying real-name ID numbers against the customer information lookup service on the bank's website from 6:40 pm on 25 November to 4:30 am on 26 November.
plain: Suhyup Bank confirmed that personal information of 54 customers leaked and reported it to the financial regulator. Edaily, citing financial-sector sources, says an attacker tried ID numbers against the bank's website lookup service.
exec: Suhyup Bank confirmed a leak of personal information of 54 customers; Edaily, citing financial-sector sources, says it came through ID-number guessing on a website lookup service.

evidence.quote: 27일 금융권에 따르면 수협은행은 전날 고객 54명의 개인정보 유출 사실을 확인하고 금융감독원에 보고했다.
해커는 지난 25일 오후 6시40분부터 26일 오전 4시30분까지 수협은행 홈페이지의 고객 본인정보 조회·관리 서비스에 확보한 실명번호를 무작위로 대입하는 방식으로 고객 정보를 조회했다.

validation.note: inews24 and Edaily (two publishers) both report the 54-customer leak; the bank's own notice was not read.

review.note: Compared 54 customers, data types, FSS report against inews24
